assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina HiSeq 2500, 1x50 bp), rat gastrocnemius
primary_estimand: Effect of 8-week treadmill endurance training on gastrocnemius gene expression within each selectively bred trainability line (LRTT vs untrained LRT; HRTT vs untrained HRT), plus the paper's Figure 2 line difference in the trained state (HRTT vs LRTT)
sample_inclusion: Generation-15 male HRT/LRT rats; n=3 untrained (HRT, LRT) and n=3 trained (HRTT, LRTT) per line, separate animals (S2.1.3.p1). HCR/LCR samples belong to a separate intrinsic-capacity comparison (case GSE155230_capacity).
planned_contrasts: HRTT vs LRTT (S3.2.p1, Fig 2C; paper: 255 DEGs, 68 up in HRTT, 187 down)
LRTT vs LRT, trained vs untrained low responders (S3.2.p3, Supp Fig 2G; deposited GSE155230_lrtt_lrt_deg: 255 DEGs, 174 up / 81 down)
HRTT vs HRT, trained vs untrained high responders (S3.2.p3, Supp Fig 2G; deposited GSE155230_hrt_hrtt_deg: 90 DEGs, 62 up / 28 down)
HRT vs LRT untrained baseline (deposited GSE155230_lrt_hrt_deg: 234 DEGs, 64 up / 170 down; used in Fig 4E pre-training comparison)
repeated_measure_unit: none: trained and untrained rats are different animals (S2.1.3.p1)
normalization: Cufflinks upper-quartile normalization, Cuffdiff -b -u (GEO data_processing; S2.3.1.p1)
